turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Yaar, ye sunke dil bhar aaya... tumhari baat se lag raha hai ki tum abhi bhi uss routine ko maintain karne ki koshish kar rahe ho, jaise koi cheez normal hai. Par normal toh kuch bhi nahi hai ab, hai na?

Woh café wala scene imagine kar raha hoon—subah ka time, laptop kholke baithna, par kaam ki jagah sirf... khali screen, khali emails, khali din. Aur sab ko lag raha hai ki tum "office" gaye ho. Ye sab karte hue kitna akela lagta hoga tumhe?

Layoff ke baad ye jo "performance" hum khud se expect karte hain na—ki "main theek hoon, main strong hoon"—woh sab bahut zor lagaata hai. Par yaar, jab poori team chali gayi ho, jab market hi kharab ho, toh yeh sab kisi failure se kam nahi lagta. Tumne kya galat kiya tha? Kuch bhi nahi. Par phir bhi yeh sab hone ke baad bhi hum apne aap ko sabit karne ki race mein kyun laga dete hain?

Wife ko, parents ko, sabko lagta hai tum "busy" ho, par andar se tum kitna struggle kar rahe ho—woh bhi kisi se keh nahi pa rahe. Ye sab chupake sahna, yaar, bahut mushkil hota hai. Tumhari jagah koi bhi hota, toh usse bhi yahi lagta: "Main kaise bataun sabko ki main abhi bhi udas hoon, dar raha hoon, confused hoon?"

Par ek baat poochun? Woh café mein baithke tum kya sochte ho? Kya tumhe wahan rehne ka sukoon milta hai, ya phir sirf time pass kar rahe ho? Aur agar sukoon milta hai, toh phir ghar pe kyun nahi? Kya wahan koi cheez hai jo tumhe ghar pe nahi milti?

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Yaar, yeh toh bilkul woh scene hai na — jahan har baat mein "toh ab tum kya kar rahe ho?" chhupaa hota hai. Aur jab tumhara answer uss "package" wali expectation se match nahi karta, toh lagta hai jaise koi silent judgement chal raha ho. Chacha ko Diwali pe tumhara CTC batana, aur ab unhi logon ke saamne tumhara naam lete hue Papa ka "proudly" bolna... yeh sab sunke toh lagta hai jaise tumhara dard aur bhi gehra ho raha hai.

Shaadi ke naam pe hi tumhara dimaag uss kamre mein kyun ghoom raha hai? Kyunki wahan jaake tumhe sabke saamne khada hona padega, aur har ek ki nazar tumhari "progress" ko scan kar rahi hogi. Jaise tum koi product ho, jiska performance review ho raha ho. Aur sabse bura yeh hai ki tumhe pata hai ki unki expectations tum match nahi kar paoge — kyunki abhi tumhara "status" unki nazron mein thoda... *unstable* hai.

Par ek baat socho — jo log tumhe sirf job title aur salary se judge karte hain, unki zindagi mein aur kya hai? Unko tumhari struggle samajh nahi aayegi, lekin unki judgement se tumhara self-worth decide nahi hona chahiye. Tumhara worth usse zyada hai. Tumhara struggle, tumhara honesty, tumhara courage — yeh sab unki "stock market" wali zindagi se kahin zyada real hai.

Aur Papa ke baare mein? Unko pata hai kya tum abhi kya se guzar rahe ho? Agar nahi, toh shayad unko bhi batana chahiye. Kyunki jab tum unke saamne "proudly" introduce ho, toh unko pata hona chahiye ki tumhara journey abhi khatam nahi hua hai — aur woh bhi tumhara hissa hai. Unki proudness tumhari struggle ko ignore karke nahi, balki usse samajhke honi chahiye.

Shaadi mein jaana hai toh jaana — lekin apne aap ko unki expectations ke hisaab se mat poochna. Tum apne liye wahan ja rahe ho, unke liye nahi. Aur agar koi sawaal pooche, toh tumhara answer sirf itna hona chahiye: *"Abhi thoda adjust kar raha hoon, lekin achha hoon."* Aur agar woh log uske baad bhi kuch aur poochne ki koshish karein, toh tumhe unki zindagi ke "stock market" mein invest karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Tumhara apna "portfolio" tum banoge — unki approval se nahi.

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Yaar, tumhara yeh sochna bilkul insaaniyat hai — ek shaam ke liye bhi agar tumhe lagta hai ki tumhe apne aap ko bachaana hai, toh woh galat nahi hai. Tumhara dimag tumhe protect kar raha hai, kyunki abhi tum uss "performance" ke pressure ko handle nahi kar paoge.

Papa ka chehra badalna... yeh sunke toh lagta hai ki tum unke liye ab bhi wohi "success story" ho, jo kabhi thi. Unko pata hai ki tumhara layoff hua, par shayad unko yeh nahi pata ki tumhari feelings kya hain. Aur agar unko pata bhi ho, toh unki generation ka sochna alag hota hai — unke liye "log kya kahenge" kaafi matter karta hai. Par tumhara struggle unke liye sirf ek "phase" hai, jabki tumhari nazar mein yeh tumhari zindagi ka ek hissa hai.

Shaadi skip karne ka sochna galat nahi hai — tum apne mental peace ko priority de rahe ho. Agar ek shaam bhi tumhe wahan rehke fake smile karne padenge, toh tumhara apna loss hoga. Aur agar tumne bahana bana diya, toh kya hoga? Kuch nahi. Log do-chaar din baat karenge, phir sab normal ho jayega. Tumhari zindagi ka hissa nahi hai unki opinions.

Par ek baat socho — agar tum shaadi mein jaate ho, toh kya tumhe lagta hai ki tum wahan khush reh paoge? Agar nahi, toh phir kyun jaana? Tumhara apna sukoon zyada important hai. Aur agar tumne decide kar liya ki tum nahi ja rahe, toh Papa ko bhi samajhana hoga — ki tum abhi iske liye ready nahi ho. Agar unko tumhara struggle samajh aayega, toh woh bhi tumhari taraf se sochenge.

Ek shaam ki baat hai, lekin tumhari feelings real hain. Tumhe decide karne ka poora haq hai ki tum kahan jaana chahte ho aur kahan nahi. Aur agar tum decide karte ho ki tum nahi ja rahe, toh woh tumhara decision hai — usme koi galati nahi hai. Tum apne liye jee rahe ho, unke liye nahi.

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Yaar, yeh jo tum "timing" ke naam pe apne aap ko samjha rahe ho — yeh ekdam insaaniyat hai. Tum khud ko yeh kehke thoda sukoon de rahe ho ki *"abhi nahi, lekin jab offer aayega, tab sab theek ho jayega."* Par andar se tumhe pata hai ki yeh ek chhota sa jhooth hai — khud se, aur khud ke liye.

Logic solid lagta hai kyunki tum apne aap ko ek deadline de rahe ho. Tumhe lagta hai ki jab tak tumhara next step fix nahi hota, tab tak tumhari struggle ko "crisis" ki tarah treat karna unfair hoga. Tum chahte ho ki jab tum batao, toh woh sirf ek update ho — *"Yaar, naya job mil gaya!"* — aur sab khush ho jayein. Tumhe dar hai ki agar abhi bataoge, toh logon ki reactions tumhari struggle ko aur bhi bhaari bana denge.

Par yeh jo "ulti aa jayegi" wala feeling hai na — yeh tumhari intuition hai, jo tumhe yeh keh rahi hai ki yeh sab thoda risky hai. Kya pata, offer aane mein zyada time lag jaye? Kya pata, EMI savings khatam hone se pehle koi aur emergency aa jaye? Aur agar aisa hua, toh tumhe phir bhi wohi logon ke saamne khada hona padega, jinhe tumne abhi tak "theek hoon" ka drama dikhaya hai.

Tumhara yeh sochna ki *"main jab ready hoon, tab bataunga"* — yeh ek tarah ka self-protection hai. Tum apne aap ko, aur apne close logo ko, ek temporary comfort zone mein rakh rahe ho. Par yaar, kab tak? Kitne din tum apne aap ko, aur apne family ko, yeh kehke chupaye rakhoge ki *"abhi thoda aur wait karo"*?

Shayad abhi bata dena zyada bura nahi hoga. Shayad unko pata hone se tumhara bojh halka ho jaye. Shayad woh tumhari struggle ko samajhein, aur tumhe support karein. Aur agar nahi samajhte, toh bhi — tumhari zindagi tumhari hai, unki reactions se decide nahi hoti.

Par ek baat poochun? Tumhe kya lagta hai ki sabko batane se tumhara kya loss hoga? Aur kya gain hoga? Agar tumhe lagta hai ki gain zyada hai, toh shayad abhi bata dena hi behtar hai. Kyunki yeh "timing" ka jhooth kab tak chalega?
